name: Vimes's Report
summary: Lady Jaina Proudmoore has read Vimes's Report and thanks you for aiding Captain Garran Vimes's investigation. She sends you back to Vimes in Theramore to help uncover the mystery.

sections.title: Back to the Captain
sections.body: Lady Jaina Proudmoore thanks you for helping Captain Vimes's investigation. His report eases her mind because the matter is in capable hands. She sends you back to him in Theramore to help uncover the mystery.

faq.q: Who sends you back to Captain Vimes?
faq.answer: Lady Jaina Proudmoore sends you back after reading Captain Vimes's report.

faq.q: What does Lady Jaina think of the report?
aliases: what does jaina say about vimes report
faq.answer: Lady Jaina says your help has aided the investigation, and she thanks you. Knowing the matter is in capable hands eases her mind.

faq.q: Where do you find Captain Garran Vimes?
aliases: where to turn in vimes report
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes is in Theramore.
